title: Alignment Diagnostics, an Integrity-Based Platform
description: Alignment Diagnostics is an integrity-based platform designed to make alignment measurable, repeatable, and accessible across domains. Its primary instrument, the Alignment Diagnostic Assessment (ADA), provides structured diagnostics that detect misalignment early, reduce escalation, and restore coherence in individuals, teams, organizations, and systems—without reliance on motivation, persuasion, authority, or domain-specific interpretation.
